notes: CRITICAL: CompactLogix does NOT have native Modbus support. Requires Add-On Instruction (AOI) from Rockwell (sample code 23503) or ProSoft MVI56E module. MSG instruction for Modbus client only, not server.

controller_status.description: Controller run/program status (if mapped via AOI)

major_fault.description: Major fault code (if mapped via AOI)

minor_fault.description: Minor fault code (if mapped via AOI)

int_array_element_0.description: Example: INT array element mapped to register 100

real_array_element_0.description: Example: REAL array element mapped to registers 200-201

bool_array_element_0.description: Example: BOOL array element mapped to coil 0

aoi_server.name: Modbus TCP Server AOI
aoi_server.description: Add-On Instruction that implements Modbus TCP server in ladder logic

prosoft_module.name: ProSoft MVI56E-MNETC
prosoft_module.description: Hardware module providing native Modbus TCP

msg_instruction.name: MSG Instruction
msg_instruction.description: Built-in instruction for Modbus CLIENT only
msg_instruction.note: Cannot act as Modbus server without AOI

configuration_requirements: Download and import AOI from Rockwell Sample Code 23503
Create user-defined tags for Modbus data
Map controller tags to AOI input/output arrays
Addresses are determined by array index in AOI configuration

_source_verified: Verified: Requires AOI or ProSoft MVI56E for Modbus TCP confirmed via Rockwell KB articles
